tinker.name: Terminal
tinker.description: Terminal emulator with SSH configuration management

zh-CN.name: 终端
zh-CN.description: 终端模拟器，支持 SSH 配置管理

list_tabs.description: List open terminal tabs with id, title, active state, and active pane id. Call this before targeting a specific tab.

activate_tab.description: Focus a terminal tab by id so it becomes the active tab in the UI.

create_tab.description: Create a new local terminal tab and focus it. Returns the new tab id and the updated tab list.

close_tab.description: Close a terminal tab by id. Fails if it is the only remaining tab. Optional tab_id defaults to the active tab.

tab_id.description: Tab id from list_tabs. Defaults to the active tab.

get_terminal_info.description: Get a terminal tab's active pane context: tab title, pane title, current working directory, and foreground process name. Optional tab_id defaults to the active tab.

tab_id.description: Tab id from list_tabs. Defaults to the active tab.

get_selection.description: Get the currently selected text in a terminal tab's active pane, if any. Optional tab_id defaults to the active tab.

tab_id.description: Tab id from list_tabs. Defaults to the active tab.

run_command.description: Run a shell command in a terminal tab's active pane by sending it followed by Enter. Output appears in the terminal. Optional tab_id defaults to the active tab.

tab_id.description: Tab id from list_tabs. Defaults to the active tab.

write_to_terminal.description: Write raw text to a terminal tab's active pane without automatically pressing Enter. Optional tab_id defaults to the active tab.

text.description: The text to send to the terminal

tab_id.description: Tab id from list_tabs. Defaults to the active tab.
